audit.why: Akali owning levels 1-5 and holding an edge at 6 matches a 51.72% Emerald+ figure over 29 games - close to even overall, with Akali ahead in lane and Kassadin's payback coming from scaling. Chart left alone; the text now explains WHY each stage tilts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as her spike with no cooldown attached, and the all-in window said 'bait the answer, then sign' without naming which answer.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s and costs zero energy, Shuriken Flip is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, Perfect Execution is 120/90/60s. Those three numbers are the whole spike map.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns and report[9].t with the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard errors. (1) The page repeatedly said Assassin's Mark HEALS her ('her passive heals her while...', 'passive Assassin's Mark heals her when she detonates an empowered auto'). It does not - Riot's text gives it bonus range and damage only, no healing. (2) wants.foe[1] said Twilight Shroud dodges 'your Null Sphere and Force Pulse'. Shroud makes her 'unable to be SELECTED by enemy spells and attacks' - that stops targeted Null Sphere, but Force Pulse is a cone and Riftwalk damages nearby units, so both still land on her inside the smoke.
audit.why: Riot description of Assassin's Mark: 'Exiting that ring empowers Akali's next Attack with bonus range and damage' - no heal clause. Twilight Shroud: 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks'. Null Sphere: 'fires an orb of void energy at a target'. Force Pulse: 'damage and slow enemies in a cone'. Riftwalk: 'dealing damage to nearby enemy units'.
audit.corrected: Removed every heal claim from content.early, spikes[0].text, whys[2] and wants.foe[0]; rewrote wants.foe[1], report[5].t and dosFull[0] around selection-vs-area damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said 'her Five Point Strike cone out-ranges my Null Sphere'. It does not.
audit.why: Five Point Strike is 550 range; Null Sphere is 650. Kassadin out-ranges her Q by 100 units, which is the only free farming position he gets pre-6.
audit.corrected: content.early, content.whys[0] and full.tldr / report[0].t now state the 650-vs-550 gap and tell you to farm from it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization ended with 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' - wrong pronoun and wrong advice.
audit.why: Akali has no healing in her current kit, so Grievous Wounds buys nothing here.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now points the last slot at Zhonya's against the Perfect Execution recast instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple full-layer fields called Akali 'him'/'his' and described her as a juggernaut.
audit.why: Akali is female and is an energy assassin, not a juggernaut - the trade rules read as boilerplate from another matchup.
audit.corrected: Fixed tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, dosFull[1], dontsFull[1], dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.trading, report[0].t and report[3].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said that Shuriken Flip can mark her own smoke cloud, or that Force Pulse charges instantly in this lane.
audit.why: Riot: 'The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target' - so Shroud plus E is a two-part escape, not just a stealth. And Force Pulse 'draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity' while her Q recycles every 1.5s.

edits.before: Akali owns these levels and it is not close. Her Five Point Strike cone chips my low base HP, and once she lands an empowered auto her passive heals her while my Null Sphere is my only tool and I have no Nether Blade mana to keep trading. I cannot fight into her energy without running dry, so I last-hit at the tip of her Q range, hold my Q shield for her E shuriken dash, and concede the wave. Do not chase her onto her Twilight Shroud — she just goes untargetable, resets, and I overextend with no escape.
edits.after: Akali owns these levels and it is not close. Five Point Strike chips my low base HP for 110 energy a cast, and stepping out of her Assassin's Mark ring hands her an empowered auto with bonus range while Null Sphere is my only tool and I have no Nether Blade mana to keep trading. My Q reaches 650 to her Q's 550, so I last-hit from outside her cone, hold the shield for her E shuriken dash, and concede the wave. Do not chase her onto Twilight Shroud - she goes untargetable, resets, and I overextend with no escape.
